reasons: The cited § 7.6 is a Vendor-granted pricing-parity warranty running in Customer's favour, which the rule expressly directs to be marked compliant and left unredlined.
No MFN, best-terms, or third-party-offer-matching obligation is imposed on Customer anywhere in the cited text, so the preferred position (no MFN burden on Customer) is met.
Consistent with a compliant finding, the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraph and no counterparty comment was raised; deterministic checks flagged nothing.

Rationale is accurate and appropriately notes that adjacent pricing/Order Form and General provisions were checked for parity or exclusivity obligations on Customer. The narrow 'Fees' definition (Implementation Fee only) limits the benefit's scope but is not a deviation under this direction rule.
